detail.longDescription: "For years, rising autism diagnoses have fueled claims that the disorder is becoming increasingly common. But a major study of more than 62,000 children has found that the underlying rate of autism may have remained remarkably stable all along, even as diagnoses have risen dramatically." https://www. newsweek.com/autism-diagnoses- rose-researchers-found-something-62000-children-12528370 # PublicHealth # healthcare # autism # screening # research
